title: I paid my way. I never borrowed a shilling in my life. Can you feel that? I owe nothing.
html_source:
Mr Deasy adopts openly an imperial self-reliant attitude to money and finance and economics.

Stephen can’t offer a retort but is ok with his borrowing and lending lifestyle.
